summary: Iter-40 integration testing of pickup → signature → PDF archive flow + PickupHistorySection mount. Backend HTTP integration suite (new /app/backend/tests/test_pickups_http.py): 6/7 PASS — full end-to-end works (basic memo_return + cert_collection create, auto_create_signature_for surfaces on /signatures/pending pad poll, /signatures/{id}/submit triggers finalize_pickup_if_linked → real PDF uploaded to Cloudinary and downloadable HTTPS URL starts with %PDF magic bytes, DELETE /pickups/{id} returns 403 for branch_admin and reverts stone_status to at_office for super_admin). Existing direct pytest test_pickups.py: 8/8 PASS. Two distinct bugs found and reported (1 backend FIXED in this iter, 1 frontend pending, 1 missing endpoint pending).

critical.issue: UnboundLocalError: 'now' used before assignment when auto_create_signature_for is provided — sig_doc on line 150 referenced `now` defined later at line 161. This made the entire 'Approve and Print' integrated flow return HTTP 500. FIXED IN THIS ITERATION by moving `now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)` above the sig_doc block. Verified by re-run: test_auto_create_signature_request_appears_on_pad and test_submit_signature_finalizes_pickup_pdf now PASS.

Endpoint declared in spec is MISSING. Only the internal helper `finalize_pickup_if_linked` exists (called from /signatures/{id}/submit). Independent re-finalize is not callable — returns 404. test_finalize_endpoint_exists FAILS. Spec also requires idempotency.

minor.issue: Returns 500 with passlib.exc.UnknownHashError — Israel branch_admin's password hash in DB is corrupted (pre-existing, not part of this iter). Workaround: tests use ofir2@bashds.com which logs in fine.

ui_bugs.issue: Component is mounted in jobs/page.tsx (verified between SignatureSection and JobActivityList) BUT does NOT render in DOM even when the job has a pickup_event. Verified on job #586 which has 1 memo_return pickup (visible in Activity timeline as `activity-row-pickup_printed`) — `[data-testid=pickup-history-section]` count is 0 in DOM. SignatureSection and JobActivityList for the same job DO render. The component's fetch silently swallows errors (try/finally without catch logs nothing), so the API call to GET /api/jobs/{job_id}/pickups is either failing on the frontend or returning empty despite backend returning the row. Backend endpoint returns data correctly when called directly with the same admin token. Suspect axios baseURL/auth header issue OR initial-render race with selectedJob.id.

action_items: Main agent: investigate why <PickupHistorySection> does NOT render in the Job dialog even when GET /api/jobs/{id}/pickups returns rows. Component's fetch swallows errors silently (try/finally only) — add `catch (e) { console.error(...) }` for visibility, OR verify axios instance/baseURL/auth header attachment for the new pickupsApi.listForJob call. Verified job #586 backend returns the pickup row but UI count is 0.

Main agent: implement POST /api/pickups/{id}/finalize route (currently missing — only internal `finalize_pickup_if_linked` helper exists). Must be idempotent (no duplicate Cloudinary uploads or activity rows).
Main agent: fix corrupted password hash for ofir1@bashds.com (passlib UnknownHashError → 500 on login). Likely needs to be re-set via the admin user-management flow.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/pickups.py line 150 had a use-before-assignment of `now` — caused 500 on the entire integrated flow when auto_create_signature_for was provided. Fixed in this iter (moved `now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)` above the optional sig_doc insert).

PickupHistorySection.tsx silently swallows fetch errors (`try { ... } finally { setLoading(false) }` — no catch). When the API call fails, the component just stays empty with no console hint. Add a catch + console.error.

POST /api/pickups/{id}/finalize is documented in the spec but the route doesn't exist — the helper finalize_pickup_if_linked is internal-only. Even if the auto-finalize-on-signature path is the primary, an independent retry/finalize endpoint is part of the spec and is missing.

Idempotency: finalize_pickup_if_linked currently overwrites the existing signed_pdf_url + uploads to Cloudinary every time it's called (no guard on existing signed_pdf_url). The Cloudinary `overwrite=True` plus deterministic public_id (timestamp-based, so actually changes each call!) means duplicate assets may accumulate if the endpoint were to be added without an idempotency check.

The component's polling at every 4s on every open Job dialog accumulates a setInterval that runs even when the dialog is closed if the React tree doesn't unmount. Confirm cleanup happens by verifying unmount.

rca of the issue: Bug 1 (FIXED): create_pickup() in routes/pickups.py referenced `now` on line 150 inside the auto_create_signature_for branch BEFORE assigning it on line 161. Any call that passed auto_create_signature_for raised UnboundLocalError → 500. Reproduction: POST /api/pickups with body {job_id, type:'memo_return', stone_ids, auto_create_signature_for:'X', signature_role:'client_collection'}. Mitigation: moved `now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)` above the optional block. Bug 2 (OPEN): <PickupHistorySection> renders null even when backend has data — needs frontend debugging; the try/finally swallows errors. Bug 3 (OPEN): /pickups/{id}/finalize route not implemented.
